info.name: Vexa PIM API
info.description:
Complete Vexa PIM API collection -- auto-generated from OpenAPI spec with example request bodies derived from actual DTO source code.

**Auth:** Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT token. Use the Auth > Login request first, then the {{access_token}} variable is set automatically.

**Base URL:** Set {{base_url}} to your environment (e.g. http://localhost:3001 or https://staging.vexa.io).

**Roles:** admin | editor | publisher | approver | channel_manager | connector_admin | reviewer | viewer

Generated: 2026-06-10

variable.description: JWT access token (auto-set by Login request)

exec: console.log("Access token saved to collection variable.");
